question.text: Outermost electronic configuration of a group <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>13</mn></math> element, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi><mo>,</mo></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mn>1</mn></msup><mo>.</mo></math> The electronic configuration of an element of p-block period-five placed diagonally to element, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi></math> is:

solution.text: The element <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Ga</mi></math> and the diagonal element of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>5</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup></math> period is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>Sn</mi><mprescripts/><mn>50</mn><none/></mmultiscripts></math> having outer electronic configuration will be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>[</mo><mi>Kr</mi><mo>]</mo><mn>5</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></mrow><mn>10</mn></msup><mn>5</mn><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>.</mo></math>
